Name: Pear Desktop Connector
Description: Control Pear Desktop from Stream Deck keys and dials using its local API Server.

Strings.Follow Shuffle State reads Pear's real s: Follow Shuffle State reads Pear's real shuffle state when pressed. Playlist playback requires a compatible Pear build with the native playlist API extension.
Strings.Long lines are shortened to fit a key. E: Long lines are shortened to fit a key. Enable Show Title and clear a custom Stream Deck title to see metadata.
Strings.Save extracts and stores the playlist ID: Save extracts and stores the playlist ID. Follow uses Pear's actual shuffle state when pressed.
Strings.Playlist playback requires a compatible: Playlist playback requires a compatible Pear build with the native playlist API extension. Pear 3.12.0 cannot start playlists. A missing or unsupported native operation alerts; no fallback playback is sent.
Strings.Clockwise increases volume or skips to t: Clockwise increases volume or skips to the next track; counter-clockwise decreases volume or goes to the previous track. Volume press toggles mute; Transport press plays or pauses. Playlist Selector rotation changes the selected entry. A short touch refreshes the display; a hold does nothing. Clear custom host title/icon overrides to see Pear's display.
Strings.Enable Pear's API Server. For local use,: Enable Pear's API Server. For local use, bind it to 127.0.0.1:26538. Approve the first request in Pear. A denied or revoked authorization needs Reauthorize.
Strings.Enter a playlist ID or a YouTube playlis: Enter a playlist ID or a YouTube playlist/watch URL with one valid list value.
